documents.text: Project Cedar is a secure document sharing prototype. Files are encrypted on the server before storage. Owners grant reviewer permissions and may revoke links. The pilot involved 24 volunteers, 180 tasks and six weeks of use. A total of 162 tasks succeeded. Most failures resulted from expired permissions rather than encryption errors. Participants requested clearer labels and faster summaries. A proposed second pilot has not started. No independent security audit has been completed; the prototype is not certified for regulated medical records.

A botany study observed 48 plant species in six plots over 12 weeks. Native mixed plantings attracted more pollinator species than monoculture plots. Roots absorb water and nutrients, while leaves use sunlight for photosynthesis. Flowers support pollination and seed production. The results describe the observed plots only and do not establish effects in other climates. The team recommends further replication before generalizing the findings.

Project Cedar enrolled 24 volunteers. Reviewers completed 162 of 180 tasks. No certification is claimed. इस परीक्षण परियोजना में 24 स्वयंसेवकों ने भाग लिया। कुल 180 कार्यों में से 162 सफल रहे। दस्तावेज़ सर्वर पर एन्क्रिप्ट किए जाते हैं। किसी स्वतंत्र सुरक्षा ऑडिट का दावा नहीं किया गया है।
